does: Browns the top of a dish under strong heat from above, until it forms a golden crust.

intro.what: Gratinating browns the top of a dish under strong heat from above.
intro.why: It separates making a golden crust from warming the dish beneath it, and teaches close attention to fast browning.

how: Cover the dish with what will brown: cheese, crumbs, or a sauce rich in butter or cream.
Set it on a high shelf, under a grill that is already hot.
Stay beside it. The crust goes from pale to burnt very fast.
Turn the dish for an even colour, and take it out when it is golden and bubbling at the edges.

cues.text: A blistered, golden-brown crust that bubbles at the rim.
Toasted cheese. A sharp, bitter smell means it has gone too far.

mistakes.fix: Watch it the whole time, with the oven door ajar.

mistakes.mistake: Grilling a dish that is cold in the middle, so that the top burns before the inside is hot.
mistakes.fix: Warm the dish in the oven first, then brown the top.

quiz.question: What is gratinating intended to create?
choices: A crust on the bottom alone.
quiz.because: Strong heat from above browns the topping into a crust.

quiz.question: How does this method position the dish for browning?
choices: On a low shelf in a cold oven.
On a high shelf beneath an already hot grill.
Under a tight lid away from top heat.
quiz.because: An already hot grill supplies the strong heat from above that browns the topping.

quiz.question: Which appearance matches the intended crust?
choices: A pale topping without any colour.
A black surface with a bitter smell.
A blistered, golden-brown top bubbling at the rim.
quiz.because: A blistered golden-brown crust is the aim. A sharp, bitter smell suggests the topping has gone too far.

quiz.question: The dish is cold in the middle before you brown its top. What comes first?
choices: Warm the dish in the oven, then brown the top.
Move the cold dish closer to the grill to heat the middle faster.
Add the topping and grill the cold dish straight away.
quiz.because: The top can burn before a cold middle warms. Warm the dish first, then use the grill to brown its surface.
